changes: Default broad scans exclude tests/**, docs/superpowers/specs/**, .docs-tools/** and site/** controls.
Default visible warnings are capped at 5 per file and 30 total.
Raw audit replay remains available with --include-tests --no-default-excludes --max-warnings-per-file -1 --max-warnings -1.
Zero cap values are rejected by the CLI; use -1 to disable a cap.

current_corpus_after_tuning.note: Same path list as M24; object count changed because validator/tests received new tuning helpers.

decision.reason: Default visible warning volume is now reviewer-sized, but this remains local advisory evidence and still lacks approved hook/CI wiring plus real AI-agent behavior proof.

delta.raw_mode_delta_reason: Raw mode uses the same path list, but current validator/tests add objects after tuning; therefore raw replay is compatibility-style, not byte-identical to the old baseline.

unsupported_claims: No hook, CI workflow, blocker, browser automation, provider/model/API call, target mutation, git action, release, deploy, publish or automation activation was performed.
This artifact does not prove real AI-agent behavior improvement; B45-PCA-M26 remains required for that claim.
